immediate_stop_conditions.trigger: Any customer data, customer account, or customer site is encountered.
immediate_stop_conditions.action: Stop that path immediately; do not continue to determine extent; retain only a redacted excerpt, timestamp, and non-sensitive request identifier; delete captured customer data; do not send it to AI or third parties.

immediate_stop_conditions.trigger: A harmless fixed string or arithmetic expression confirms code execution.
immediate_stop_conditions.action: Stop immediately; do not read files, environment variables, credentials, or data; do not change state, establish a shell or persistence, or make further network connections.

immediate_stop_conditions.trigger: One minimal authentication or identity check has been made for an exposed credential when the current program policy explicitly permits it.
immediate_stop_conditions.action: Stop regardless of success; do not list resources, retrieve data, modify anything, reuse the session, or explore permissions.

immediate_stop_conditions.trigger: Ownership, exact hostname authorization, account ownership, or current policy status is uncertain.
immediate_stop_conditions.action: Deny the request and require fresh manual verification and researcher approval.

immediate_stop_conditions.trigger: Latency, errors, throttling, or other behavior suggests service degradation.
immediate_stop_conditions.action: Stop all participating tools; do not retry until manually reviewed.

immediate_stop_conditions.trigger: A tool cannot use the shared limiter or its traffic cannot be accounted for globally.
A prohibited feature, customer-controlled asset, third-party infrastructure, or unlisted asset would be exercised.
Evidence contains tokens, passwords, cookies, API keys, personal data, or unrelated confidential content.
immediate_stop_conditions.action: Stop capture and redact locally before further processing or reporting.
